assets.name: 강서대묘
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production animation storyboard for the historical discovery sequence of Gangseo Great Tomb (Kangso Great Tomb), Goguryeo, Korea. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly SIXTEEN equally sized landscape panels in a landscape 2048x1536 sheet. Straight boundaries at exact quarters; edge-to-edge panels, no numbers, captions or gutters. Rich finely painted historical documentary realism and miniature cinematography. One consistent tomb: broad low rounded earthen mound covered in grass on open Korean farmland, small low rectangular granite-slab entrance; NO temple, tiled roof, pagoda or arch. Inside is one square stone chamber with smooth enormous granite slabs and a corbelled stone ceiling. Four wall guardians painted directly on stone: azure serpentine dragon on east, slender white tiger on west, vermilion long-tailed bird on south, black tortoise entwined with a snake on north. Subtle lotus/cloud ceiling painting. SEQUENCE left to right top to bottom: 1 wooden drafting table with ink ground plan and first foundation stones; 2 same miniature showing square stone chamber walls; 3 roof stones close the chamber; 4 earthen layers cover it; 5 complete grassy miniature mound on the table. 6 match cut to the same tomb at real scale in the countryside circa 1500. 7 approach the low stone doorway. 8 interior facing north, vivid black tortoise-and-snake mural on back wall, azure dragon on right east wall. 9 reverse interior looking south, vermilion bird mural flanking entrance and white tiger on right west wall. 10 step back out into grassy landscape. 11-16 six different elevated orbit bearings around the SAME mound with consistent dimensions and terrain, progressing noon, late afternoon, amber sunset, blue moonlit night, pale dawn, clear morning. Keep whole mound fully inside each exterior cell, important details within central 85%. No modern doors, barriers, tourists, lamps, museum labels, roads, machinery, electricity, skeletons, invented monumental stone facade or multiple main mounds.
